verses.text: And it came to pass in the days when the judges judged, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
verses.line: 1:And it came to pass in the days when the judges judged that there was a famine in the land And a certain man of Beth lehem judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab he and his wife and his two sons

verses.text: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.
verses.line: 2:And the name of the man was Elimelech and the name of his wife Naomi and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion Ephrathites of Beth lehem judah And they came into the country of Moab and continued there

verses.text: And Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left, and her two sons.
verses.line: 3:And Elimelech Naomi s husband died and she was left and her two sons

verses.text: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelt there about ten years.
verses.line: 4:And they took them wives of the women of Moab the name of the one was Orpah and the name of the other Ruth and they dwelt there about ten years

verses.text: And Mahlon and Chilion died both of them; and the woman was left of her two children and of her husband.
verses.line: 5:And Mahlon and Chilion died both of them and the woman was left of her two children and of her husband

verses.text: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that Jehovah had visited his people in giving them bread.
verses.line: 6:Then she arose with her daughters in law that she might return from the country of Moab for she had heard in the country of Moab how that Jehovah had visited his people in giving them bread

verses.text: And she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.
verses.line: 7:And she went forth out of the place where she was and her two daughters in law with her and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah

verses.text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters-in-law, Go, return each of you to her mother’s house: Jehovah deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
verses.line: 8:And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law Go return each of you to her mother s house Jehovah deal kindly with you as ye have dealt with the dead and with me

verses.text: Jehovah grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.line: 9:Jehovah grant you that ye may find rest each of you in the house of her husband Then she kissed them and they lifted up their voice and wept

verses.text: And they said unto her, Nay, but we will return with thee unto thy people.
verses.line: 10:And they said unto her Nay but we will return with thee unto thy people

verses.text: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? have I yet sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
verses.line: 11:And Naomi said Turn again my daughters why will ye go with me have I yet sons in my womb that they may be your husbands

verses.text: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should even have a husband to-night, and should also bear sons;
verses.line: 12:Turn again my daughters go your way for I am too old to have a husband If I should say I have hope if I should even have a husband to night and should also bear sons

verses.text: would ye therefore tarry till they were grown? would ye therefore stay from having husbands? nay, my daughters, for it grieveth me much for your sakes, for the hand of Jehovah is gone forth against me.
verses.line: 13:would ye therefore tarry till they were grown would ye therefore stay from having husbands nay my daughters for it grieveth me much for your sakes for the hand of Jehovah is gone forth against me

verses.text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clave unto her.
verses.line: 14:And they lifted up their voice and wept again and Orpah kissed her mother in law but Ruth clave unto her

verses.text: And she said, Behold, thy sister-in-law is gone back unto her people, and unto her god: return thou after thy sister-in-law.
verses.line: 15:And she said Behold thy sister in law is gone back unto her people and unto her god return thou after thy sister in law

verses.text: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, and to return from following after thee, for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God;
verses.line: 16:And Ruth said Entreat me not to leave thee and to return from following after thee for whither thou goest I will go and where thou lodgest I will lodge thy people shall be my people and thy God my God

verses.text: where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: Jehovah do so to me, and more also, if aught but death part thee and me.
verses.line: 17:where thou diest will I die and there will I be buried Jehovah do so to me and more also if aught but death part thee and me

verses.text: And when she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, she left off speaking unto her.
verses.line: 18:And when she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her she left off speaking unto her

verses.text: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and the women said, Is this Naomi?
verses.line: 19:So they two went until they came to Beth lehem And it came to pass when they were come to Beth lehem that all the city was moved about them and the women said Is this Naomi

verses.text: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara; for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.line: 20:And she said unto them Call me not Naomi call me Mara for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me

verses.text: I went out full, and Jehovah hath brought me home again empty; why call ye me Naomi, seeing Jehovah hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
verses.line: 21:I went out full and Jehovah hath brought me home again empty why call ye me Naomi seeing Jehovah hath testified against me and the Almighty hath afflicted me

verses.text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.line: 22:So Naomi returned and Ruth the Moabitess her daughter in law with her who returned out of the country of Moab and they came to Beth lehem in the beginning of barley harvest
